settings.title: Mint
settings.text:
• Essentially new with virtually no signs of wear and tear. Only a detailed visual inspection will reveal signs of use. 
  • Equipment works perfectly with all their functions and clean and clear of any defects.
  • Comes with a 90-day warranty.

settings.title: Excellent
settings.text:
• Noticeably used with average signs of wear. Could have up to two small dings or blemishes.
  • Cameras will work perfectly with all their functions.
  • Lenses work perfectly and only have an insignificant amount of internal dust.
  • Comes with a 90-day warranty.

settings.title: Good
settings.text:
• Noticeably used with more than average signs of wear. Has more than two small dings or blemishes.
  • Camera is fully operational with all functions. 
  • Lens works perfectly but can have insignificant internal dust, haze, or fungus. But, won't have more than 1 of these defects.
  • Comes with a 90-day warranty.

settings.title: One-Off
settings.text:
• Noticeably used with more than average signs of wear. Has more than two small dings or blemishes. 
  • The camera is missing some functions and the missing functions are listed in the product description.
  • The lens works perfectly but can have insignificant internal dust, haze, or fungus. All defects must be listed.
  • Comes with a 90-day warranty.

settings.title: AS-IS
settings.text:
• Products graded as so have not tested, are non-functional, or are damaged. Equipment may not work.
  • No returns are accepted for AS-IS items.
  • Does NOT come with a 90-day warranty.

settings.title: Repair or Parts Only
settings.text: These items are not for sale and are kept for repair or parts. If you have a request for parts you may contact us at hello@coastalfilmlab.com

settings.heading: Detailed Visual Inspection
settings.row_content: A visual inspection with the use of a flash light and or loupe magnifier.

settings.heading: Noticeable
settings.row_content: Visible without the use of a flash light and or loupe magnifier.

settings.heading: Blemish
settings.row_content: Wear in the leatherette or body smaller than 0.5” in diameter. Scratch less than 0.5” in length.
